# CBC News

> > Canada's national public broadcaster providing comprehensive news coverage, multimedia content, and historical archives of Canadian and international events.

CBC (Canadian Broadcasting Corporation) delivers breaking news, in-depth reporting, and cultural content across Canada and worldwide. The site features extensive photo galleries, world news coverage, and CBC Archives documenting decades of Canadian history and significant global events.

## Key Topics

- Canada
- CBC News
- Canadian history
- World news
- Photo galleries
- Multimedia content
- Historical archives
- Toronto
- Ontario
- Quebec
- International affairs
- Cultural heritage
- Breaking news
- Canadian media

## News Coverage

- [World - CBC News](https://rss.cbc.ca/news/world/): Latest world news covering international affairs and breaking stories

## Multimedia & Photo Galleries

- [Photo galleries - CBC News](https://rss.cbc.ca/news/photos/): CBC News photo galleries showcasing multimedia news content

## Archives & Historical Content

- [CBC Archives](https://archives.cbc.ca/): CBC Archives featuring historical Canadian news, culture, and events
